# Overview

Monitor application performance and resource usage in Laravel Cloud.

Laravel Cloud includes observability tools for your applications and the resources they use.

## Explore observability features

> [card] [Metrics](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/metrics/overview)
>
> See how traffic changes over time and track resource usage such as CPU and memory.

> [card] [Requests](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/requests)
>
> Find your busiest pages, investigate errors, and understand response times.

> [card] [Logs](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/logs)
>
> Search application logs, HTTP access logs, and scheduled command output.

> [card] [Notifications](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/notifications)
>
> Choose which Cloud events trigger email or Slack notifications.
